How to learn — 3 rounds

Round 1 — Retrieve & Translate: Look at the scene and read the Russian sentence. First recall the exact English collocation out loud — every word, right article and preposition — then translate the whole sentence watching the verb form (deal → dealt, grind → ground, play → played). Stuck on the phrase? Click 💡 Hint before you flip — never flip just “to peek”. Need an easier first pass? Turn on 🧩 + EN gap & meaning.
Round 2 — Sort & Drill: Mark each card I know it! (only if you got both the exact phrase and its grammar form right before flipping) or Still learning. Then press 🎯 Practise tricky ones and repeat until the tricky pile is empty. Getting too easy? Switch the front to 🖼️ Picture only!
Round 3 — Connect & Produce from Memory: No cards face-up! Explain how new inventions disrupt old industries using 4 phrases (spell the end, fall into decline, trigger the demise, play a role), retell a historical crisis using 4 phrases (sack the city, deal a deathblow, grind to a halt, swell the ranks), and tell a true story from your own school or daily life using at least 4 phrases!
